ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous irregular white field localized on the medial-to-distal region of the left lobe; discrete white linear striations and fine mottling localized on the medial section of the right lobe adjacent to the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations distributed across the entire trailing edge; three distinct macro-scale notches visible on the left lobe and one significant indentation on the right lobe's upper quadrant.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by an upward parabolic arc extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes and interspersed along the trailing edge topography.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as high-contrast white tracks against the dark-pigmented central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent traumatic indentations (notches) on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive parallel rake mark scarring across the mid-section of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'brush-stroke' pigmentation pattern where white intensity bleeds into black regions on the left lobe's interior boundary.
